tools.name: analyze_files
tools.description: Analyzes specific paths, or the entire project, for errors.

roots.title: The project roots to run this tool in.

root.title: The file URI of the project root to run this tool in.
root.description: This must be equal to or a subdirectory of one of the roots allowed by the client. Must be a URI with a `file:` scheme (e.g. file:///absolute/path/to/root).

paths.title: Paths to run this tool on. Must resolve to a path that is within the "root".

applyFixes.description: Whether or not to automatically apply quick fixes before returning diagnostics. Defaults to false.
